Units & revenue by SKU — paid demand, True Gross basis

Top Movers

Ranked for the selected channel and period, with a year-over-year comparison against the same window one year prior — on both units and revenue (True Gross, paid basis; ties to the analytics dashboard). Paid excludes free FOTM/BOGO units so promo distribution doesn't inflate demand. Search, filter, sort any column, and click a row for that SKU's chart. Paged at 10 rows so the sections below stay reachable; sorting and filtering apply to the whole matching set before paging, so page 1 is always the real top of the ranking. SKUs with 0 units in the selected period are hidden by default — they didn't move — and the number hidden is shown on the toggle.

Volume by Product Type

Total sales volume compared across product types for the period and channel selected above, then click any type to break that type down by size. Type comes from the product line (Herbal Coffee, Herbal Tea, Instant Coffee, …), not from packaging format. Size comes from the CatalogSmith product master. Sizes inside a type stay grouped by basis — an 11 oz × 3 multipack is never added to a bare 11 oz, because the unit sold is the pack. Size shares are within a (type, basis); the type total is a plain unit count and does span bases.

Channel and period follow the Top Movers controls above. The category and size filters do not apply here — this section IS the type and size breakdown.

Size Mix

Units by product size for the period selected above, against the same window one year prior. Size comes from the CatalogSmith product master (size_class / size_basis) — not from the SKU code. Each basis is its own table on purpose. The master declares every basis comparable with itself only, so an 11 oz × 3 multipack is never added to a bare 11 oz: the unit sold is the pack. Shares are within a basis, never across.

Channel, period and category follow the Top Movers controls above. The size filter and search do not apply here — this table IS the size breakdown.

SKU History

Search any SKU for its full monthly units & revenue chart — or click any row above. Opens paid / free / wholesale / subscription / total unit splits, with paid and subscription revenue overlays (True Gross & actual-paid) on a second axis.
